what.text: This page follows refugees from Slovenia living in Serbia and Kosovo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2004, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 463 Slovene refugees in Serbia and Kosovo, 79.8% of all refugees from Slovenia that year.
Today, UNHCR counts only a few refugees from Slovenia, in Germany and Denmark.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Slovenia, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1993 and 1994.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 1993, at its highest figure, 28429 refugees, to 2004.
The data has no figure after 2004.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Serbia and Kosovo.
These are year-end totals for Serbia and Kosovo only, reported to UNHCR from 1993 to 2004.
